title: Kanipinche Bandalanni – Darma Shali K Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: కనిపించే బంధాలన్నీ దేవునివే కనిపించని దేవుని ప్రేమను తెలుపుటకే
లాలించి ఆడించే ప్రేమ తనదేనే అదృశ్య దేవుని ఆప్యాయతకు రూపమే
చెలిమి చేసాడు చెల్లిగా అన్నీ నేనే అన్నాడు అన్నగా
అమ్మ ప్రేమ నాన్న ప్రేమ అందరి ప్రేమలు తనవే
సోదరులను ఇచ్చాడు అండగా వారే ఆత్మ బంధువులు అన్నాడుగా
ఇద్దరు కాదు ముగ్గురు కాదు పెద్ద కుటుంబమే ఇచ్చాడు
english: Kanipinche bandhalanni Devunive kanipinchani Devuni premanu teluputake
Laalinchi aadinche prema thanadhene adrushya Devuni aapyaayathaku rupame
Chelimi chesaadu chelligaa anni nene annaadu annagaa
Amma prema nanna prema andhari premalu thanave
Sodharulanu icchaadu andagaa vaare aathma bandhuvulu annaaduga
Iddharu kaadu mugguru kaadu pedda kudumbame icchaadu
translation: Chorus
All the visible bonds we have are from God;
They exist only to reveal the invisible love of God.
The love that nurtures and plays with us is truly His;
A family is simply a physical form of the unseen God’s affection.
The whole family should be filled with God-like affection;
Though asked to stay united, people have separated through conflicts.
The entire family must unite together in the work of the Gospel.
Verse 1
He fed us in the form of a Mother and nourished us as a Father;
He offered friendship as a Sister and stood by us as an elder Brother.
A mother’s love, a father’s love—all these various loves belong to Him;
He has manifested Himself through everyone and dwells within all.
The entire family must join the Body of Christ (the Church);
We must transform our blood relations into spiritual bonds.
Like the family of Moses, everyone should become servants of God.
Verse 2
He built the Church and taught us to live as a family through love;
He gave us brothers and sisters as support, calling them our spiritual kin.
He didn’t just give us two or three relatives, but a massive family;
By placing His Spirit in everyone, He declared that we are all one.
Blood relations may eventually break, but spiritual bonds are eternal;
You have endured physical ties, now cherish the spiritual ones.
The Church is our true family; no matter the flaws, we must forgive one another.
intro: Kanipinche Bandalanni is the latest Telugu Christian song written by King Srinu, tuned by Darma Shali K, sung by Parvathi Meenakshi, produced by Srinu B. This song was released on March 12, 2026, through Word Of Jesus Christ YouTube Channel.
